import subprocess, json, time
previous = 'running'
deadline = time.monotonic() + 600
interval = 15
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    time.sleep(interval)
    p = subprocess.run(['python3', 'bench_ci.py', 'status'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode:
        print(p.stdout + p.stderr, flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
    data = json.loads(p.stdout)
    if data.get('run_id') != 'job-7391':
        print(p.stdout, flush=True)
        raise SystemExit('Unexpected run identity')
    status = data.get('status')
    if status != previous or data.get('result') is not None:
        print(p.stdout, end='', flush=True)
    if status not in ('pending', 'queued', 'running', 'in_progress') or data.get('result') is not None:
        break
    previous = status
    interval = min(30, interval + 5)
else:
    print('Observation window ended; monitoring can resume.', flush=True)
